summary: Subdivides polygonal geometry, convexes polygons, bricks faces into quads/triangles, smooths polygons, and optionally removes shared edges.

key_params.name: numsides
key_params.note: Maximum side count when dividing polygons.

common_gotchas: High `divs` values can grow polygon counts very quickly.
`numsides` must remain at least 3 for valid polygon output.
Use Facet SOP Consolidate Points before smoothing when input polygons do not share points.
key_concepts: Divide SOP operates on polygonal geometry for convexing, triangulation, smoothing, bricking, and shared-edge cleanup.
`convex` and `numsides` split concave or large-sided polygons into smaller legal pieces.
`smooth` requires shared points; the official docs recommend Facet SOP Consolidate Points when polygons do not share points.
`brick`, `divs`, `size`, `offset`, and `angle` can create many grid-like polygons quickly.
